items.title: Middle East war live: Iran Revolutionary Guard official says renewed war with the US unlikely
items.description: The deputy political chief of Iran's Revolutionary Guard said on Wednesday that the possibility of a renewed war with the United States was "low'", but warned that Iran's armed forces were "lying in wait with full magazines" against any future attacks. Follow our liveblog for all the latest developments.

items.title: Israeli strikes kill at least 31 in south Lebanon as Israel expands ground operations
items.description: The Israeli military issued evacuation warnings for at least 50 Lebanese towns on Tuesday. Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu said his army was 'reinforcing the security buffer zone to protect the communities of northern Israel.'

items.title: Ukraine: Russian attack destroys humanitarian food aid in Dnipro
items.description: The World Food Programme (WFP) has deplored a Russian attack on a warehouse in Dnipro, Ukraine that destroyed “a significant quantity” of food aid destined for thousands in frontline areas.

items.title: Putin offers debt relief to new recruits for Ukraine war
items.description: New recruits for Russia's war in Ukraine will have debts up to 10 million rubles canceled under a presidential decree. Another new law reportedly foresees the use of Russian armed forces to protect citizens abroad.

items.title: Frontline Kramatorsk Hit By Russian Air Strike; Casualties Reported
items.description: Russian forces struck the frontline city of Kramatorsk with aerial bombs, damaging residential buildings and injuring more than 10 people on May 25, according to local officials. Residents described shattered windows, destroyed apartments, and panic moments after the blasts.

items.title: Russia threatens more strikes against Kyiv after drone and missile attack
items.description: As Kyiv recovers from a Russian attack that hit every district in the Ukrainian capital, Ukraine continues long-range strikes on Russia's war machine even as the Kremlin threatens more strikes.

items.title: Leaders eye on Belarus for signs it might offer Russia help in Ukraine
items.description: Belarus’ exiled opposition leader visits Kyiv as the city recovers from Russia’s largest missile attack of the year. World leaders are closely watching Belarus’ potential support for Russia’s invasion.

items.title: Everything We Know About the Deadly Ukrainian Strike in Occupied Luhansk
items.description: Russia said at least 21 people were killed in the overnight strike on a college dormitory, while Ukraine denied targeting civilians.
